newsitem.title: USA: Datapoint Corp names president, new CFO.
newsitem.headline: Datapoint Corp names president, new CFO.

text.p: Datapoint Corp, which designs and manufactures computer and communication products, said Friday that directors promoted Blake Thomas to fill the vacant office of president and it has hired a new chief financial officer.
Thomas, currently executive vice president and chief operating officer, will continue as Datapoint's chief operating officer, a position he has held since December 1995.
The company said the board also appointed Phillip Krumb to the board of directors. Krumb, currently vice president and chief financial officer of Datapoint, will continue as a company vice president.
Datapoint said Krumb will be leaving his post as CFO to become assistant to the chairman, Asher B. Edelman.

Datapoint said Ronald Conn has joined Datapoint as vice president and CFO, replacing Krumb. Conn most recently was with the architectural/engineering firm of Pellham-Phillips-Hagerman as chief executive officer for two years.
Conn will join Thomas at the company's international headquarters in Paris to focus on the company's operations in Europe which acounts for more than 97 percent of Datapoint's business.
